mediaWork.title: Chasing Me to My Grave: An Artist's Memoir of the Jim Crow South
mediaWork.creatorName: Winfred Rembert with Erin I. Kelly
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Memoir of survival and artistry during the Jim Crow era, including wrongful arrest and incarceration
mediaWork.summaryNotes: A memoir combining prose and painted leather, this book recounts the author's survival and artistic journey during the Jim Crow era.  It details his wrongful arrest and incarceration, highlighting systemic racism and lack of due process within the legal system. The book offers a first-person account of enduring an unjust system,  combining personal narrative with visual art to process trauma and historical injustice.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Hardcover, paperback, ebook, 304 pages with 4-color images throughout
